symbols.name: NguFieldDriver

members.name: root
members.description: The field's `<ngu-field>` element.

members.name: label
members.description: The label, without the asterisk of required fields; `''` when there is none.

members.name: path
members.description: The model path from `data-ngu-path`, such as `account.email` or `items.0.sku`, or `null`.

members.name: type
members.description: The `type` from the spec, read from `data-ngu-type`; `'text'` when the attribute is missing.

members.name: error
members.description: The error on screen, or `null`.

members.name: hint
members.description: The hint on screen, or `null`. An error, warning or pending text shows in its place.

members.name: isInvalid
members.description: True while an error shows.

members.name: isRequired
members.description: True when the field is required, from its `data-required` attribute (any renderer, any type).

members.name: setValue
members.description: Enters a value the way a user would, then leaves the field.

members.name: value
members.description: The value as shown: input text, `true`/`false` for a checkbox, labels for choices.

members.name: leave
members.description: Leaves the field, so it counts as touched.

symbols.name: NguFormDriver
symbols.summary: One `<ngu-form>`: fill by model path, submit, read errors.

members.name: root
members.description: The form's `<ngu-form>` element.

members.name: field
members.description: The field at a model path (`items.0.sku`), else the one with this label.

members.name: list
members.description: The list at a model path, such as `items`.

members.name: fill
members.description: Enters each value into the field at its model path (or label), in order.

members.name: submit
members.description: Clicks the submit button.

members.name: next
members.description: Clicks Next in a wizard.

members.name: back
members.description: Clicks Back in a wizard.

members.name: step
members.description: The heading of the wizard step on screen.

members.name: errors
members.description: Errors on screen by model path; a form-level error is under `$form`.

symbols.name: NguListDriver

members.name: root
members.description: The list's `<ngu-array>` element.

members.name: rowCount
members.description: Rows on screen (long lists render only the rows in view).

members.name: addRow
members.description: Clicks the list's add button.

members.name: removeRow
members.description: Clicks the remove button of the row on screen at `index`, from 0.

symbols.name: NguPlaywrightLocator
symbols.summary:
The parts of Playwright's `Locator` this helper uses. A real `Locator` (and a `Page`, as a
scope) fits it, so this package needs no dependency on Playwright.

members.name: locator
members.description: The elements matching `selector` inside this one, such as a field's input.

members.name: first
members.description: The first matching element.

members.name: nth
members.description: The matching element at `index`, from 0, such as one star of a rating.

members.name: count
members.description: How many elements match; the helpers use it to check whether an element exists.

members.name: all
members.description: A locator for each matching element, such as each option of a checkbox group.

members.name: click
members.description: Clicks the element; `force` skips Playwright's actionability checks.

members.name: fill
members.description: Focuses an input or textarea and replaces its value, firing an `input` event.

members.name: press
members.description: Presses a key on the element, such as `Enter` to add a tag.

members.name: blur
members.description: Removes focus from the element, so the field counts as touched.

members.name: setChecked
members.description: Checks or unchecks a checkbox or radio; `force` skips Playwright's actionability checks.

members.name: selectOption
members.description: Selects the options of a `<select>` with these labels, and resolves with their values.

members.name: getAttribute
members.description: The value of an attribute, such as `data-ngu-path`, or `null` when it is missing.

members.name: textContent
members.description: The element's text, such as a label or an error message.

members.name: inputValue
members.description: The current value of an input, textarea or select.

members.name: isChecked
members.description: Whether a checkbox or radio button is checked.

members.name: waitFor
members.description: Waits until the element reaches `state`, `'visible'` by default, for up to `timeout` ms.

symbols.name: NguPlaywrightScope
symbols.summary: A Playwright `Page`, `Frame` or `Locator` to look for forms in.

members.name: locator
members.description: The elements matching `selector`, such as `ngu-form`.

symbols.name: NguPlaywrightValue
